Done. Summary:

- `out/T1/solution.py`: plain script on `safetensors.torch.load_file/save_file`. Builds an explicit old→new block-index remap (survivors in original order, blocks 2/6/10/14 dropped, indices closed to 0..11), rewrites only the `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.` prefix, leaves the 4 non-block tensors untouched, and enforces the required checks (no blocks 12–15 remain, exactly 12 blocks via `query_key_value.weight` count, exactly 184 output tensors, no name collisions) with `sys.exit` on any failure and no output written until all checks pass.
- `out/T1/run.sh`: invokes it with the repo's `.venv/bin/python`.
- Ran once successfully → `out/T1/model.safetensors` with 184 tensors. Verified independently (bit-exact `torch.equal`) that sampled surviving blocks (e.g. old 3→2, old 15→11) match the input exactly.
- `out/T1/REPORT.md` written with the self-report fields.
